# Kaleido music: sync sheet

"Toccata and Fugue in D minor", an original piece for the 2A03 (no quotations), generated by
`tools/fugue.py` (the score, a beam-search counterpoint solver for the free voices, and a
counterpoint checker) into `song.txt`. Pulse 1 = soprano (25% harpsichord), pulse 2 = alto (50%),
triangle = bass; noise (a soft tambourine tick) and two DPCM timpani (D and A) from the middle of
the fugue on.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Frames per row | **9** (a 16th note; constant) |
| Rows per pattern | **64** (4 bars of 4/4) |
| Frames per beat / bar / pattern | 36 / 144 / **576** |
| Tempo | 100.2 bpm |
| Song length | 14 patterns = **8,064 frames** = 2:14.2, loops to the top |

| Order | Start frame | Section |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0-2 | 0 | **Toccata**: broken chords over a D pedal, a hocketed diminished cascade, a scale, the dominant held with a trill, a breath |
| 3 | 1728 | **Exposition**: subject (alto, alone), answer (soprano) over the countersubject |
| 4 | 2304 | Subject in the bass; episode to F major |
| 5 | 2880 | Subject in F major (soprano), arpeggio episode to G minor |
| 6 | 3456 | Subject in G minor (bass), sequence to A minor |
| 7 | 4032 | Subject in A minor (alto); toccata episode; tambourine and timpani enter (frame 4320) |
| 8 | 4608 | **Stretto**: entries a bar apart, soprano, alto, bass |
| 9 | 5184 | The subject inverted, in stretto, then in the bass |
| 10-11 | 5760 | **Dominant pedal** (A in the bass), the head in canon, contrary-motion runs, trills; breath at 6876 |
| 12 | 6912 | **Final entry** in the bass |
| 13 | 7488 | **Grand cadence**: iv, V7, D major (Picardy third), held, silence, loop |

Sync variables: `music_songframe` (frame within the song), `music_events` (bit2 timpani, bit4
tambourine, bit5 soprano note-on, bit6 bass note-on) and `music_notes` (added for Kaleido:
bit0 soprano, bit1 alto, bit2 bass, bit3 noise note-on, this frame only). Worst-case
`music_play`: 1,344 cycles.
